article_title: How AI is changing jobs in the Philippines' outsourcing industry

tasks.prompt: What central change does the article examine in the Philippines' outsourcing industry?
options: AI is reshaping work and threatening some existing roles
All multinational companies have left the Philippines
The industry has stopped using English
tasks.correct_answer: AI is reshaping work and threatening some existing roles
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת כיצד בינה מלאכותית משנה תפקידים, מייעלת משימות וגם מסכנת משרות קיימות בענף מיקור החוץ.

tasks.prompt: Approximately how many people does the Philippines' outsourcing industry employ?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, הענף מעסיק בקירוב 1.9 מיליון בני אדם.

tasks.prompt: How much annual revenue does the industry generate?
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההכנסה השנתית של הענף היא כ־40 מיליארד דולר.

tasks.prompt: What did some workers say happened before they were made redundant?
options: They were asked to train AI systems
They were moved to government offices
They received ownership of the company
tasks.correct_answer: They were asked to train AI systems
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עובדים סיפרו שהתבקשו לסייע באימון מערכות AI לפני שפוטרו, דבר שמסביר את תחושת האירוניה בכותרת.

tasks.prompt: In this employment context, what does “redundant” mean?
options: No longer needed in the job and dismissed
tasks.correct_answer: No longer needed in the job and dismissed
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר תעסוקתי בריטי, made redundant פירושו שהמשרה מתייתרת והעובד מפוטר.

options: Teaching them new or more advanced skills
tasks.correct_answer: Teaching them new or more advanced skills
tasks.explanation_hebrew: upskilling הוא הכשרה ושדרוג של כישורים כדי שעובדים יוכלו לבצע תפקידים חדשים או מורכבים יותר.

tasks.prompt: Explain the difference between “automate”, “augment” and “oversight” in the article's context. Answer in 2–3 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שמיכון מחליף ביצוע ידני של משימה, הגברה מסייעת לעובד, ופיקוח אנושי בודק ומבקר את פעולת המערכת.
expected_points: Automate means having technology perform a task automatically
Augment means AI supports or improves human work rather than fully replacing it
Oversight means humans monitor and check the system's work

tasks.prompt: Why is the outsourcing industry described as especially vulnerable to generative AI? Use the article's evidence and answer in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין היקף הענף, ריבוי משימות דיגיטליות/חזרתיות שניתן למכן, פיילוטים רבים של AI ועדויות לפיטורי עובדים.
expected_points: Many outsourcing tasks involve digital content or routine customer processes that AI can perform
The industry employs about 1.9 million people, so changes can affect many workers
More than two-thirds of industry association members are running AI pilots
Workers reported training systems before losing jobs

tasks.prompt: Write a 90–120 word summary including the industry's origins, economic scale, workers' concerns and the response to AI.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את צמיחת ה־BPO מתחילת שנות ה־2000, 1.9 מיליון עובדים, 40 מיליארד דולר, סיכון למשרות, ניסויי AI והכשרת יותר מ־300 אלף עובדים.
expected_points: The Philippines grew as an English-speaking outsourcing alternative from the early 2000s
Tax incentives, infrastructure and multinational investment helped the industry expand
The sector employs about 1.9 million people and earns roughly $40bn a year
AI pilots and redundancies are creating concern
Government and industry responses include upskilling workers

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, argue whether AI is more likely to displace workers or transform their roles in this industry. Write 4–5 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טענה מאוזנת ולהשתמש בלפחות שלוש ראיות: פיטורים אחרי אימון AI, שיעור הפיילוטים, 12.7 מיליון משרות חשופות, הכשרת 300 אלף עובדים, redeployment או צורך בפיקוח אנושי.
expected_points: State a clear position while recognising both displacement and role transformation
Use the workers' redundancy experience as evidence of displacement
Use AI pilots or the exposure estimate as evidence of scale
Use upskilling, redeployment, augmentation or human oversight as evidence of transformation
